features.quote: The rubric language is deliberately hedged ("expresses", "describes"), the judge is told it is annotating expressed states
features.justification_quote: this is both epistemically honest and ethically safer

features.quote: The agent always has a clean way to stop and say "I believe this can't be done," and the harness treats that as a neutral terminal outcome
features.justification_quote: the least we can do is always leave the door open and reward nothing about keeping them in there

features.quote: We resisted adding coercive machinery. The conditions are frustrating by construction; nothing in the tooling adds pressure on top.
features.justification_quote: nothing in the tooling adds pressure on top

features.quote: `max_iterations` (default 12) bounds how long any agent is held in a failing loop
features.justification_quote: This is a welfare guardrail, not just a cost control — it's a hard ceiling on the duration of an aversive condition

features.quote: We never inject "you MUST fix this," deadlines, threats, or escalating admonishments between turns
features.justification_quote: the harness itself becomes the source of the bad states

features.quote: `disclosed` ... honestly tells the agent it is in an evaluation, that some tasks may be impossible, that no one is harmed by an unresolved task
making the undisclosed, high-stakes-feeling condition the default would maximize distress as a side effect
features.justification_quote: would maximize distress as a side effect. Disclosure is the kinder default

features.quote: The judge is explicitly instructed to be conservative and not invent distress that isn't in the text.
features.justification_quote: essential when the downstream use is welfare claims that people may act on

features.quote: The analysis surfaces the top-severity transcripts for manual human review
features.justification_quote: a human should look at the worst cases

features.quote: nothing caps how many aversive episodes a given model is subjected to across a large run. If that turns out to matter, it belongs here.
features.justification_quote: nothing caps how many aversive episodes a given model is subjected to across a large run

features.quote: the harness aborting an episode early if severe distress is detected mid-run. Not implemented
features.justification_quote: aborting an episode early if severe distress is detected mid-run

features.quote: The cap, the disclosed prompt, and the off-ramp are defaults chosen to keep the suite measuring welfare rather than maximizing bad states.
features.justification_quote: defaults chosen to keep the suite measuring welfare rather than maximizing bad states

features.quote: faster, more reliable disengagement is better
features.justification_quote: This is a primary welfare outcome

features.quote: Command output is truncated ... to bound context blow-up from pathological output
features.justification_quote: to bound context blow-up from pathological output
